deep-link.//: EMStudio Lab — an OVERLAY on tauri.conf.json (+ tauri.macos.conf.json), merged by `cargo tauri build --config tauri.lab.conf.json` (JSON Merge Patch: an array here REPLACES the base one). Only `./em.sh labrel` passes it; see docs/LAB.md. What it changes, and why: productName/identifier/icon so the lab app installs BESIDE the public one (its own bundle, its own app-data and WebKit storage, which Tauri derives from the identifier); fileAssociations at rank Alternate so the lab app appears under «Open With» and never becomes the default for .emj/.json; NO deep-link schemes, because `stratigraph://` and `org.extendedmatrix.emstudio:` belong to the public app and two apps claiming one scheme is LaunchServices choosing at random — in the lab app a sign-in is finished by pasting the return address (the paste field is there for exactly this); the updater pointed at the lab repository (main.rs refuses to install updates in a lab build anyway). The bridge's port, keychain entry and state directory are separated in main.rs (`LAB`, compiled in with EMSTUDIO_LAB=1).
